briefdescription.para: Verify VRAM budget exceeded is classified as kQuotaExceeded.

detaileddescription.para:
When GPU memory allocation fails due to insufficient VRAM:
Classification: kQuotaExceeded
Recovery policy: kFallbackCPU
Expected behavior: Graceful degradation to CPU path

briefdescription.para: Verify allocation denied triggers CPU fallback.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When GPU allocation fails, subsequent operations:
Do not attempt further GPU calls
Execute deterministically on CPU
Return correct result (verified via parity check)

briefdescription.para: Verify exception safety when quota is exceeded.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: No resource leaks, no half-initialized state

briefdescription.para: Verify kernel timeout is classified as kKernelTimeout.

detaileddescription.para:
When kernel execution exceeds SLA (5 seconds):
Classification: kKernelTimeout
Recovery policy: kFallbackCPU
Expected behavior: Immediate timeout + CPU fallback

briefdescription.para: Verify timeout triggers CPU fallback.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When kernel timeout detected:
GPU kernel is terminated (or skipped in simulation)
CPU path executes deterministically
Result matches CPU-only execution within tolerance

briefdescription.para: Verify 5-second SLA is enforced.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: KernelSLAGuard with 5-second deadline detects timeout when checking after deadline.

briefdescription.para: Verify timeout emits diagnostic information.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When timeout occurs, spdlog diagnostic includes:
Kernel name/identifier
Expected vs actual duration
Fallback reason

briefdescription.para: Verify device offline is classified as kBackendUnavailable.

detaileddescription.para:
When GPU device is offline or driver error occurs:
Classification: kBackendUnavailable
Recovery policy: kMarkUnavailable
Expected behavior: Mark device unavailable, fallback to CPU

briefdescription.para: Verify device offline triggers CPU fallback.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When backend unavailable:
Device is marked unavailable for duration
All subsequent operations degrade to CPU
Results are deterministic (CPU-only)

briefdescription.para: Verify device is marked unavailable when backend fails.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: After backend unavailable error, device state reflects unavailability

briefdescription.para: Verify H2D/D2H failure is classified as kMemoryCommunication.

detaileddescription.para:
When host-device memory transfer fails (H2D or D2H):
Classification: kMemoryCommunication
Recovery policy: kRetryOnce
Expected behavior: Retry once, then fallback to CPU

briefdescription.para: Verify H2D/D2H failure triggers CPU fallback.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When memory transfer fails:
Single automatic retry
If retry fails or is skipped, CPU fallback
Result is deterministic (CPU-only)

briefdescription.para: Verify retry protocol: attempt once, then fallback.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: Retry logic is deterministic and bounded

briefdescription.para: Verify NaN detection is classified as kNumerical.

detaileddescription.para:
When numerical errors occur (NaN, inf, precision loss):
Classification: kNumerical
Recovery policy: kEmitWarning
Expected behavior: Emit warning, continue with result

briefdescription.para: Verify NaN detection emits warning without stopping execution.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When NaN detected:
Warning is logged via spdlog
Computation continues (result may be NaN)
Caller receives result with NaN flag (or actual NaN value)

briefdescription.para: Verify NaN values are properly detected.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: Numerical checks can identify NaN and inf values

briefdescription.para: Verify unsupported config is classified as kUnsupportedOperation.

detaileddescription.para:
When kernel is not available for given config:
Classification: kUnsupportedOperation
Recovery policy: kFallbackCPU
Expected behavior: Skip GPU, execute CPU path

briefdescription.para: Verify unsupported config triggers CPU fallback.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When kernel unsupported:
GPU path is skipped entirely
CPU path executes (fallback)
Result is deterministic (CPU-only)

briefdescription.para: Verify unsupported operation emits diagnostic.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: Diagnostic includes which operation and why it's unsupported

briefdescription.para: Verify complete error handling sequence: detect → classify → recover.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: All error classes flow through handler correctly

briefdescription.para: Verify error recording is thread-safe.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: Concurrent error recordings don't corrupt state

briefdescription.para: Verify every error class has a defined recovery policy.

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: No error class maps to kUnknown policy

briefdescription.para: Verify CPU fallback produces results matching CPU-only execution.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance: When GPU fails and falls back to CPU:
Result matches pure CPU computation
Error within tolerance (1e-5 relative for FP32)
used_gpu flag is set to false

briefdescription.para: Verify FP16 results are within tolerance (1e-3 relative).

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: FP16 computation tolerance is properly documented and enforced

briefdescription.para: Verify BF16 results are within tolerance (5e-3 relative).

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance: BF16 computation tolerance is properly documented and enforced

briefdescription.para: Comprehensive error handling tests for GPU Block 3 Phase 5 - Integration & Verification.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests all error classes from Phase 1 taxonomy:
test_quota_exceeded_fallback: allocation denied → CPU path
test_kernel_timeout_fallback: timeout → CPU path
test_backend_unavailable_fallback: device offline → CPU path
test_memory_communication_failure: H2D/D2H failure → CPU path
test_numerical_error_handling: NaN detection → warning
test_unsupported_operation_fallback: unsupported config → CPU path
All tests verify GPU/CPU result parity (or CPU-only execution). Minimum 12 test cases required for Phase C acceptance.
